en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a long, low institutional building with many windows and a tiled roof, labeled as a police school. In front of the building is a garden area with a path, a small pavilion or gazebo, and a few people in uniform standing near the entrance. Additional multi‑story buildings can be seen in the background. The style suggests an early 20th‑century European scene.
